name: hostelhub
description: HostelHub — a full-stack MERN hostel management system

scripts.setup: npm install --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix backend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev --no-audit --no-fund
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
